results.query: How many customers do we have?
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Customer) as total_customers
FROM `arizona-poc.copa_export_copa_data_000000000000.customer_master_analysis`

SELECT
    GL_Account,
    GL_Acct_Long_Text,
    CM_SS_GLACCOUNT_BUCKET_Code,
    New_CM_SS_GLACCOUNT_BUCKET_Desc
FROM `arizona-poc.copa_export_copa_data_000000000000.GL_Accounts`
ORDER BY GL_Account

SELECT
  Segment_Name as customer_segment,
  ROUND(Monetary_sum, 2) as total_revenue,
  CAST(Customer_count AS INT64) as customer_count,
  ROUND(Monetary_mean, 2) as avg_revenue_per_customer
FROM `arizona-poc.copa_export_copa_data_000000000000.segment_performance_summary`
ORDER BY Monetary_sum DESC

results.query: What are the top 10 customers by revenue?
results.sql:
SELECT
  Customer,
  ROUND(Monetary, 2) as revenue
FROM `arizona-poc.copa_export_copa_data_000000000000.customer_master_analysis`
ORDER BY Monetary DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  Year_Month,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(Net_Sales, 0)), 2) as monthly_revenue
FROM `arizona-poc.copa_export_copa_data_000000000000.time_series_performance`
GROUP BY Year_Month
ORDER BY Year_Month

results.query: Show sales orders with customer information
results.sql:
SELECT
  so.SalesDocument_VBELN as Sales_Order,
  so.Item_POSNR as Item,
  so.Header_Creation_Date as Order_Date,
  so.SoldToParty_KUNNR as Customer_ID,
  so.MaterialNumber_MATNR as Material,
  so.MaterialDescription as Material_Description,
  ROUND(so.SalesOrderNetPrice, 2) as Net_Price,
  ROUND(so.SalesOrderQty, 2) as Order_Quantity,
  so.SalesUnit_VRKME as Unit,
  so.OverallProcessingStatus_GBSTA as Processing_Status,
  so.Delivery_Block_Status as Delivery_Status
FROM `arizona-poc.copa_export_copa_data_000000000000.sales_order_cockpit_export` so
WHERE so.SalesDocument_VBELN IS NOT NULL

WITH CustomerSpending AS (
  SELECT
    Customer,
    COUNT(DISTINCT Sales_Order_KDAUF) as order_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(Gross_Revenue, 0)) as total_spending,
    AVG(COALESCE(Gross_Revenue, 0)) as avg_transaction_value,
    MIN(Posting_Date) as first_purchase_date,
    MAX(Posting_Date) as last_purchase_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT Fiscal_Year_Period) as active_periods
  FROM `arizona-poc.copa_export_copa_data_000000000000.dataset_25m_table`
  WHERE Customer IS NOT NULL
    AND Posting_Date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR)
  GROUP BY Customer
)
SELECT
  Customer,
  CAST(order_count AS INT64) as order_count,
  ROUND(total_spending, 2) as total_spending,
  ROUND(avg_transaction_value, 2) as avg_transaction_value,
  first_purchase_date,
  last_purchase_date,
  CAST(active_periods AS INT64) as active_periods,
  CASE 
    WHEN total_spending >= 1000000 THEN 'High Value'
    WHEN total_spending >= 100000 THEN 'Medium Value'
    ELSE 'Low Value'
  END as spending_tier
FROM CustomerSpending
WHERE total_spending > 0
ORDER BY total_spending DESC

SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(Gross_Revenue, 0)), 2) as gross_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(Total_COGS, 0)), 2) as total_cogs,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(Gross_Revenue, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(Total_COGS, 0)), 2) as gross_margin
FROM `arizona-poc.copa_export_copa_data_000000000000.dataset_25m_table`

SELECT
  Year,
  CASE 
    WHEN Month IN (1, 2, 3) THEN 'Q1'
    WHEN Month IN (4, 5, 6) THEN 'Q2'
    WHEN Month IN (7, 8, 9) THEN 'Q3'
    WHEN Month IN (10, 11, 12) THEN 'Q4'
  END as Quarter,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(Net_Sales, 0)), 2) as net_sales,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(Gross_Margin, 0)), 2) as gross_margin,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(Total_COGS, 0)), 2) as total_cogs,
  SUM(Customer) as customer_count,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(Inv_Quantity_Cases, 0)), 0) as total_volume,
  ROUND(AVG(Margin_Percent), 2) as avg_margin_percent
FROM `arizona-poc.copa_export_copa_data_000000000000.time_series_performance`
GROUP BY Year, Quarter
ORDER BY Year, Quarter

SELECT 
    Fiscal_Year,
    Fiscal_Year_Period,
    GL_Account,
    GL_Account_Description,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(GL_Amount_in_CC, 0)), 2) as total_amount,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
FROM `arizona-poc.copa_export_copa_data_000000000000.dataset_25m_table`
WHERE Posting_Date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)
GROUP BY Fiscal_Year, Fiscal_Year_Period, GL_Account, GL_Account_Description
ORDER BY Fiscal_Year DESC, Fiscal_Year_Period DESC, total_amount DESC
